seo.title: Bio-Rad ID-Card equipment | LabWell
seo.description: Bio-Rad ID-Card equipment: the ID-Centrifuge L centrifuge, the ID-Incubator L incubator and the semi-automated IH-Reader 24. Supplied in Ukraine by LabWell.

G1_hero.lead: Bio-Rad ID-Card equipment is a centrifuge, an incubator and a reading instrument for immunohematology testing with gel cards. ID-Centrifuge L and ID-Incubator L are designed for manual procedures with ID-Cards and tubes, while IH-Reader 24 centrifuges ID-Cards and reads their gel images in a semi-automated workflow.

keyFacts.label: rotor heads compatible with ID-Centrifuge L

image.alt: Bio-Rad equipment for immunohematology testing with ID-Cards

items.title: ID-Centrifuge L
items.text: A centrifuge for manual procedures with ID-Cards and tubes.

items.title: ID-Incubator L
items.text: An incubator for up to 36 ID-Cards and 24 tubes with independent zones.

items.title: IH-Reader 24
items.text: A semi-automated instrument for centrifugation and digital reading of ID-Cards.

ID-Centrifuge L is a Bio-Rad centrifuge for manual immunohematology procedures with ID-Cards and tubes. The instrument automatically detects the installed rotor head and selects the matching program. Heads are available for 24 ID-Cards, 28 or 12 tubes, and two racks.

keyFacts.label: ID-Cards and tubes in one instrument

ordering.footnote: Ask a LabWell manager about configuration.

items.text: ID-Incubator L is a Bio-Rad incubator for manual immunohematology procedures with ID-Cards and tubes. Independent incubation zones let you work with different formats in one instrument: three batch timers are available for ID-Cards and two for tubes. Dimensions are 380 × 500 × 230 mm and weight is 13 kg without heads.

ordering.footnote: Ask a LabWell manager about configuration.

items.text: IH-Reader 24 is a semi-automated Bio-Rad instrument that centrifuges ID-Cards and reads their gel images after manual preparation. Results are interpreted using IH-Com. According to the manufacturer, results can be transferred to the LIS or viewed remotely via IH-Web.

keyFacts.label: result transfer, according to the manufacturer

T10_faq.h2: Questions and answers about ID-Card equipment

items.q: Which ID-Card equipment is shown on this page?
items.a: ID-Centrifuge L, ID-Incubator L and IH-Reader 24 — Bio-Rad instruments for immunohematology testing with ID-Cards.

items.q: How many ID-Cards and tubes does ID-Incubator L hold?
items.a: ID-Incubator L holds up to 36 ID-Cards and up to 24 tubes. The ID-Card and tube zones can be used independently.

items.q: Which rotor heads are available for ID-Centrifuge L?
items.a: Four heads are available: for 24 ID-Cards, for 28 tubes, for 12 tubes and for two racks. The centrifuge automatically detects the installed head.

items.q: What does IH-Reader 24 do and how does it work with IH-Com?
items.a: IH-Reader 24 centrifuges ID-Cards and captures digital images of their gels after manual preparation. Results are interpreted using IH-Com software.

items.q: Who supplies Bio-Rad ID-Card equipment in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Bio-Rad distributor in Ukraine. The company helps select the most effective solution for your needs, supplies equipment and provides application support.
